name: Zord Lords
summary: A boss-battle mission where Super Moverz work together to defeat powerful multi-life villains before time expires.
overview: Zord Lords is a boss-battle mission where Super Moverz work together to defeat powerful multi-life villains before time expires. Players must coordinate movement, targeting, spacing, and equipment use while avoiding elimination during escalating encounters with multiple Zord Lords.
setup: Create a Super Mover Base circle using cones. Place a Zord Lord Circle 20–30 yards away in the open field. Position blockers, inflatables, or tunnels throughout the play area. Assign one Zord Lord inside their circle. Distribute soft dodge balls to approximately half of the Super Moverz. Set a round timer (typically 2 minutes).
steps: Level 1 — Single Zord Lord: Super Moverz begin inside their base circle (safe zone).
One Zord Lord starts inside the center field circle with two Zabers and has three lives.
When music begins, Super Moverz leave base and attempt to remove all three lives.
Players with balls may throw at the Zord Lord. Players without balls focus on spacing, positioning, and timing support.
When the Zord Lord is tagged, play freezes, the coach counts down 5 seconds, and the Zord Lord repositions anywhere in the field.
If a Super Mover is tagged, they remain down until the round ends. No rescues allowed during the round.
The mission succeeds when all Zord Lord lives are removed before time expires.

Level 2 — Two Zord Lords: Add a second Zord Lord (Condor role using Zields) and provide additional balls to Super Moverz. The first Zord Lord enters play alone; after it loses all lives, the second Zord Lord is released. After the second loses all lives, both Zord Lords regenerate with one life each and the final battle begins against the remaining Super Moverz.

Level 3 — Three Zord Lords: Add a third Zord Lord (staff or swing ball role). Zord Lords are released one at a time — defeat the first to release the second, defeat the second to release the third. After the third is defeated, all Zord Lords and all Super Moverz regenerate and the final battle begins with everyone active.
powerDown: Tagged Super Moverz remain down until the round ends.
levelUp: Level 1 — Single Zord Lord with three lives
Level 2 — Two Zord Lords released one at a time
Level 3 — Three Zord Lords, then a full-regeneration final battle
